name: Two pointers (slow / fast)
whenToUse: The standard answer: one pass, in place, and the kept values stay in their original order.

card.signals: "remove in place" (no copy allowed), "return k" and "the first k elements". Together they point to two pointers that move in the same direction: fast reads, slow writes.
card.pattern: two pointers, same direction: both move left to right. One pass, O(n) time, O(1) extra space. Each element is read once and copied at most once.
card.coreIdea: fast reads every element. When it is not val, copy it to slot slow and move slow on. At the end, slow is k: the number of values kept.

invariant: Left of slow: exactly the values read so far that are not val, in their original order. slow never passes fast.

legend.text: slow: next slot for a kept value
